s.t: Are you a talented Senior Product Manager looking for a remote job where you can showcase your skills and earn competitive compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — a marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

Your rate will depend on your seniority level, skills, and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers and other specialists.
No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — we’ll handle the business side so you can focus on delivering successful projects.
Choose a schedule that works best for you. Async communication or minimal overlap with team working hours is possible.
We respect your seniority, so you can expect no micromanagement or screen tracking.
Communicate directly with clients and stakeholders. Many of them come from technical or product backgrounds.
We’ll support you from the moment you submit your application throughout all stages of our cooperation.
Most of our projects involve fast-paced startup environments — ideal for proactive and adaptable professionals.

8+ years of experience in Product Management
8+ years of experience in Product Strategy and 5+ years of experience with SDLC/Market & Competitive Analysis
OR
5+ years of experience in Product Strategy and 8+ years of experience with SDLC/Market & Competitive Analysis

Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us or the client down.
Adaptability and flexibility — the ability to onboard onto a project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

We have a variety of projects, so if you have 4+ years of commercial software development experience and are proficient in AI Agent Architecture, AI Automation Architecture, AI Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, React & Python, React & Golang, Golang, React & Java, React & Ruby, Ruby, PHP & Vue, Vue & Node.js, React & .NET, Android & iOS, Flutter, Blockchain (Ethereum/Ethers.js/Wagmi/Viem/Solana), Angular & Node.js, Vue & .NET, Python & Vue, DevOps with Azure DevOps, MLOps, Data Science, Angular & PHP, Angular & .NET, Symfony & React, Symfony & Vue, Symfony & Angular, Python, Symfony & JavaScript & Next.js & TypeScript, Data Analysis, React & PHP, Data Engineering, Project Management, QA Automation, QA Manual, Embedded Software Engineering, React Native & Node, React Native & React, React Native & Ruby, React Native & Python, WordPress, Android, Data Annotation, Angular, Python & Node, React & Node.js, Java & Spring, Svelte & Python, Svelte & Node.js, Svelte & TypeScript, Rust, Shopify & JavaScript, Vue & Nuxt, PHP & Laravel, UI/UX Design, Animation, Graphic Design, React & Node & React Native, .NET & C#, Electron, Scala, C++, Unreal Engine & C++, Python & LLM, Unity, or Machine Learning Engineering, we would be happy to connect with you and match you with a project that fits your experience.
We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.
We work with professionals from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

Who we are
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.
Stripe Apps connect Stripe with the tools businesses already use, bringing relevant data and workflows into the Stripe Dashboard and third-party systems. The Strategic Apps team owns a portfolio of integrations with enterprise systems that are critical to our users’ workflows—from quote-to-cash and support to reporting. We help users embed Stripe more deeply into the way they run their businesses.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to set the strategy and lead execution for Strategic Apps. You will own a portfolio of existing and new integrations, including those with systems such as Salesforce, and determine where Stripe should invest based on user needs, Stripe’s product and industry priorities, and market signals. You will work across Stripe and directly with external partners to deliver reliable, high-quality integrations that drive adoption and business outcomes.
Own the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a portfolio of strategic apps, making and communicating clear trade-offs amid significant ambiguity.
Identify, prioritize, and validate the highest-value user problems and integration opportunities through direct user research, ecosystem analysis, and quantitative evidence.
Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Sales, User Support, Marketing, Partner Management, and other product teams to deliver and evolve integrations end to end.
Partner with Engineering to define product requirements, technical approach, and quality standards for integrations, including APIs, documentation, edge cases, reliability, security, compliance, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish feedback loops and measurement plans before launch; use product, business, and user metrics to assess efficacy, diagnose changes in performance, and continuously improve adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes.
Represent Stripe’s product strategy with strategic technology partners and enterprise users, building productive relationships with product and technical counterparts and incorporating their feedback into roadmap decisions.
Drive launches, beta programs, user acceptance testing, and go-to-market readiness in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Partner Management, and Support; ensure teams have the materials and operating model needed to support adoption at scale.
Make and drive important cross-functional decisions, align senior stakeholders around a shared strategy, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly.
Balance new feature development with investment in quality, reliability, technical debt, and foundational platform capabilities across the app portfolio.
Improve how Stripe builds and operates strategic integrations by turning user, partner, and performance signals into scalable product and process improvements.

8+ years of relevant product-management, engineering, or equivalent experience, including ownership of a high-quality product or feature area at scale or a major evolution of an existing product.
Experience setting product strategy and driving execution across multiple cross-functional teams or a complex product area, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and iteration.
Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative evidence to define success metrics, evaluate product performance, and make prioritization decisions.
Strong technical judgment and fluency working with engineers on API-based products, integrations, technical constraints, and product quality.
Experience engaging directly with enterprise users and external technology partners, and translating their needs into clear product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and leading through organizational boundaries.

Experience with enterprise business systems and workflows, such as CRM, ERP, quote-to-cash, support, or reporting platforms; familiarity with Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics is a plus.
Experience building or scaling platform, ecosystem, marketplace, or partner-integrated products.
Experience growing product adoption, usage, or revenue through product-led and go-to-market initiatives.
Experience in payments, financial technology, or other regulated technology environments.
A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Austin or San Francisco (Hybrid)

For 30 years, the web has run on a simple economic bargain: trading content for human attention. That attention has been monetized through advertising, subscriptions, and e-commerce. This bargain funded the Internet as we know it.
But as agents become the dominant Internet users, the model is breaking. An agent does not look at ads or need to maintain a monthly subscription to all the tools it wants to access. It reads a page or consumes a data feed once, takes what it needs, and moves on. Across the web, AI crawlers already request content anywhere from a hundred to tens of thousands of times for every visitor they send back . We need new business models, fit for this new era.
Cloudflare has spent years detecting bots, allowing domain owners to take control of whether bots can access them. What's been missing is the other half: how agents interact with those sites once they're let in. That's what our team, the Agentic Internet team is focused on: making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable .

These four primitives are all built on open standards, so no single company owns the rails. Cloudflare believes in the open Internet, and we're in a position to help build the future where it thrives. Come help us make it happen!
You can read more about some of our big bets here and here .

Shape the product strategy for new Internet-scale business models
Deliver product specifications, prototypes, product positioning, and high-impact launches
Partner with Engineering, Design, Research, and GTM to ship at high velocity
Work with Partnerships and BD to define the new business models for the open web
Represent the product externally with users, customers, AI labs, developers, and more

5+ years as a technical PM; developer-facing experience and AI/ML preferred
A builder: you get things done, can move quickly, and prefer ‘show’ over ‘tell’
A strong communicator who is comfortable with ambiguity

Payments, FinTech, or blockchain experience is a plus

How we work
At Cloudflare, performance is about outcomes (what you did) and behaviors (how you did it). We value curiosity, humility, empathy, and doing the principled thing. Learn more about our values on our Careers page .
Why this role
You’re joining a fast-moving team, breaking new ground. Read more about some of our big bets here and here .

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

MongoDB’s Security Product Management team is seeking a Staff Product Manager to own security, compliance, and public sector product strategy within Atlas for Government (A4G). In this role, you will be a key member of the security product management team, helping make data security a market differentiator that enables MongoDB to win in enterprise and regulated industries.
You will lead product strategy and execution for capabilities and programs that support federal compliance requirements and broader regulated-industry needs. You will work across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to translate complex regulatory and customer requirements into clear product investments, roadmaps, and outcomes.
This role is suited for a candidate who can orchestrate multiple interlinked product areas, own cross-team product and architectural trade-offs, and align senior stakeholders around multi-year bets. You will be expected to identify opportunities and dependencies that cut across team boundaries, bring clarity to ambiguous problem spaces, and establish reusable ways of working that help MongoDB deliver secure, compliant platform capabilities for public sector and other regulated markets.
You will partner closely with senior engineering and business leaders to evaluate trade-offs, sequence investments, and bring clarity to decisions that balance customer impact, execution risk, and long-term business value.
This role can be based out of of our offices or remotely in the United States.
The Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) is a US government-wide program that provides a standardized approach to security assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring for cloud products and services. Our FedRAMP program requires that anyone who is accessing customer data or metadata inside the Authorization Boundary be a US Person on US Soil.

Okta enables universal, secure access to technology for every user and organization. We are hiring a Product Manager to drive our Zero Trust Authentication group. In this role, you will lead the core execution, performance, and deployment strategy for Okta’s foundational endpoint products. You will own the operational excellence of Okta Verify , FastPass , and Device Assurance , ensuring that our core passwordless authentication flows and device posture engines remain performant, secure, and incredibly easy for global enterprises to deploy at scale.

What you will own
You will bridge user experience and deep systems engineering to ensure our core authentication products scale reliably for millions of global users.
Core Device Assurance Execution: Own the roadmap for our baseline security posture checks (such as OS version validation, disk encryption, and firewall status). You will manage the execution of our posture policy engine and our first-party EDR/MDM signal integrations.

Your day is a constant balancing act between core platform execution and immediate customer support. You might start your morning on a call with a strategic customer, taking tactical feedback on a Device Assurance integration and helping them design a phased rollout plan to migrate their users to FastPass. You partner deeply with your engineering leads and architects, debating technical trade-offs and ensuring that project requirements are clearly defined, scoped, and directly tied to delivering concrete solutions for our customers.
In the afternoon, you collaborate with your product peers to ensure that foundational device signals map cleanly to downstream capabilities like Identity Threat Protection or core policy evaluations. You write highly detailed, plain-prose specifications with clear problem statements to guide developer execution.

You close the day working with our Go-To-Market and support teams, ensuring they have the technical documentation and tooling needed to diagnose customer issues, resolve endpoint friction, and drive up FastPass activation rates.

When travelers are searching for a hotel, we want the obvious choice to be trivago! By comparing prices from major booking sites, we're making it easy for people to find hotels they want at a price they'll love. In the lively city of Düsseldorf, we seize opportunities to learn everyday, innovate, and make an enduring mark on the travel industry.

A career at trivago is a journey designed for people who crave continuous development and want to thrive in a high-performing team. Here you will find those who aren't afraid of change but rather embrace it, turning every challenge into a pathway for growth. Join trivago, work with a great team, and grow with us!
Join us in making a difference
At trivago, our product organization is focused on outcomes that drive real user value and meaningful business impact. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own strategy and execution for key monetization levers — spanning loyalty mechanics, pricing optimization, deal value, and retention across core user journeys . This is a role with genuine commercial ownership and the autonomy to shape direction across a multi-quarter roadmap.
You thrive when strategy and execution are firmly in your hands — building rigorous business cases, designing clear experimentation agendas, and leading cross-functional teams from insight to shipped product.

You'll partner closely with Analytics, Data Science, UX, Research, and Engineering, influencing decisions at the intersection of user experience and commercial performance . trivago is a place where high standards and genuine support go hand in hand — we invest in each other's growth while pursuing ambitious goals.

Ready to turn great user value into sustainable growth? Apply now.

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for retention & monetization areas driving direction with a high level of autonomy and influencing priorities across multiple teams, backed by quantified opportunities (LTV, contribution margin, conversion, repeat behavior).
Build and defend business cases for new initiatives - model trade-offs, pressure-test assumptions with real data, and influence stakeholders on investment priorities and expected returns.
Lead structured discovery end-to-end — identify and validate high-impact opportunities, quantify expected impact (uplift ranges, confidence levels, cost of delay), and connect them to a clear KPI framework.
Own the full experimentation agenda - hypothesis framing, test design, sequencing, and guardrails - driving fast learning while protecting user trust and making decisions from results.
Lead Analytics, Data Science, UX, Research, and Engineering from insight to shipped product — maintaining clarity on commercial and user outcomes throughout. Act as integrator across Finance, Marketing/CRM, Supply, and Legal where relevant.
Mentor less experienced product managers and actively contribute to product management processes and practices across the company.

6-12+ years of product management experience with a proven track record of shipping and scaling complex, data-driven initiatives - ideally spanning monetization, growth, pricing, or retention in a consumer product.
Strong commercial and analytical rigor - you're comfortable with experimentation results, cohort analysis, and opportunity sizing, and you make principled decisions when metrics trade off against each other.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management . You influence across functions and levels, articulate trade-offs crisply, and drive alignment - including with senior leadership.
Technical fluency. You don’t need to code, but you can partner effectively with engineering and data teams and understand system constraints and trade-offs.
High bar for UX. You know monetization works best when value is clear and the experience feels seamless.
A genuine learning mindset - you approach challenges with curiosity, seek out feedback, and continuously look for ways to develop and grow.
A performance mindset - you set ambitious goals for yourself and have the determination and resilience to follow through and achieve them.
An open and curious mindset toward AI tools and automation — you actively explore how AI can enhance your work and are excited to grow alongside evolving technologies.
Not ticking every box? We still want to hear from you. Apply, tell us what motivates you, and you could be a great match—now or in the future. Your application does not need to include a photo. This is the recruitment process that you can expect for this role (subject to modifications):

Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.
We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

AI is changing how people create and consume content, and the Insights product area is where Mentimeter turns that shift into an advantage rather than something we retrofit later. It's the area that decides what every one of our users sees, learns and does next, to turn data into something valuable enough to come back for, and in turn drive retention and expansion for our business.
As Senior Product Manager, Data / ML, you'll own the data and ML depth of Insights: the intelligence that turns every interaction into sharper results, insights and recommendations, pulls in context from inside and outside Mentimeter, and gets better the more it's used. With 300 million users' worth of interaction data behind it, the mandate is to turn that into a defensible asset. The data and ML is the means; a system that drives measurable outcomes for users and the business is the end.
This is a senior, hands-on role with a clear mandate. You'll report to the Product Director of Insights: the Director owns the area's place in company strategy and its org shape, while you own the data and ML depth that delivers it. You'll work alongside the other product managers in the area, our Staff Engineers, our Science Lead, the Office of the CTO, and our data platform teams. The exact shape of the teams is still forming, and you'll help shape it.
In your first year, success looks like a clear direction the area is bought into, and the first solid evidence that the system is compounding.

Own the data and ML direction
Set the data and ML direction for the area and get alignment behind it across product, engineering and leadership.
Turn raw interaction data into immediately useful, actionable insight for users, at the individual level and aggregated up to the organization, measured by whether people come back and act on it.
Keep recommendations grounded in science, not just patterns in the data, working closely with our Science Lead to keep what we surface credible and defensible.
Build the intelligence platform, for UI and agents
Own the platform that generates insights and recommendations: opinionated, grounded in our thought leadership, and built so the rest of the suite can build on top of it.
Make that intelligence usable two ways at once, surfaced directly in Mentimeter's UI and exposed so our AI companion and external agents can act on it, with a clean separation between the logic and context layer and the experience layer.
Build the ranking and timing that gets the right insight to the right user at the right moment, getting sharper from what lands.
Partner with Staff Engineers on the architecture and technical bets: you bring the product judgment and the outcomes the system must serve, they own the technical design.
Make it learn, and prove it
Define the measurement and experimentation standards the area scales by, so we only scale what shows durable lift against a strong baseline.
Show, with evidence, how the system's insights and recommendations get sharper over time as it learns from feedback, for example through reinforcement learning.
Own how we ship AI well: anticipate failure modes, set quality bars, guard against feedback loops that reinforce errors, and roll back cleanly when the model is wrong.
Make pragmatic calls on when to reach for ML, GenAI or something simpler, proving value before scaling.

An experienced data / AI product leader
Several years leading data-driven or ML-backed products end to end, from discovery through rollout, ideally in B2B SaaS.
Experience with recommendation engines or similar ranking and personalization systems is highly relevant, and familiarity with AI ecosystems and integration patterns such as MCP is a bonus.
You build the data system, not just the surface
You've shipped data or AI products where the core value is the system itself, and you're comfortable reasoning about pipelines, models, and how data compounds over time.
You've led shared-capability or platform work where the real win was adoption and alignment across teams, not just shipping features.
Commercially minded and outcome-driven
You connect product decisions to business outcomes like retention, expansion and durable engagement, and treat data and ML as how you get there, not the point in itself.
You have a bias for the simplest solution that works, you resist over-engineering, and you have good judgment on when advanced ML or GenAI is worth the trade-off.
Rigorous and AI-native
Strong on experimentation, with real fluency in A/B testing, incrementality and causal inference.
Fluent in shipping AI responsibly and well: eval sets, failure modes, and a clear sense of what "good enough" looks like before something goes live.
A leader who multiplies others
You lead through influence and coaching, make progress in ambiguity through iterative learning and clear decision points, and bring out the best in the people around you.
Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway and let us know why you'd enjoy working in this role at Mentimeter.
Practical details
This role is based in our Stockholm office, primarily onsite with the option to work from home twice per week.
Swedish is not required. Daily work is carried out in English, and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ nationalities.
A cover letter is not required as part of your application.

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The salary range for this role is SEK 70,000–SEK 91,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.
Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.
In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm .
What Mentimeter can offer
At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues.

We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter.

Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

Who we are
Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and evolve Create & Design, the product where every Typeform begins.
Every customer starts here. The builder is where ideas become forms, where brands come to life, and where our promise of beautifully designed, effortless experiences is either delivered or lost.
As Typeform expands beyond forms into new surfaces and AI powered experiences, the builder needs to evolve too. The challenge is no longer just creating great forms. It is creating a platform that powers every future creation experience, while making world class design accessible to everyone.
In this role, you will own Create & Design end to end. You’ll define the strategy for our builder, evolve the shared platform beneath it, and work closely with Typeform AI to make creating great experiences faster, smarter, and more intuitive for every customer.
Your work will define how millions of people create with Typeform, today and in the future.

The Create & Design team owns the core builder experience that powers every Typeform. From the editor and design system to version history, multilingual creation, brand kits, and custom domains, this is the surface where every customer creates.
The team sits within the Data Capture group and works closely with Blocks, Multi Format, Typeform AI, Response Data, Growth, and Design to build a creation experience that is simple on the surface, powerful underneath, and ready for the next generation of AI powered workflows.
This is one of the most important product surfaces at Typeform, and one that will define how creation evolves over the coming years.
Things you will do
Own the Create & Design roadmap and product strategy, aligning it with the broader Data Capture vision
Evolve the builder into the best place to create beautiful, engaging experiences
Platformise the shared capabilities that power creation across current and future surfaces
Partner with Typeform AI to bring AI assisted design, content generation, translation, and creation workflows into the builder
Define how AI helps creators produce better work while maintaining a high quality, human experience
Lead complex platform investments and technical migrations alongside customer facing product development
Partner closely with engineering and design to balance product craft with technical complexity
Shape the long term vision for creation at Typeform and sequence investments against that strategy
Monitor advances across AI, design tools, creator platforms, and modern productivity software to identify new opportunities
Work cross functionally with engineering, design, research, marketing, customer success, and commercial teams
Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery, analysis, prototyping, documentation, and decision making
What you already bring to the table
A strategic product thinker with strong product instincts and high ownership
Experience building creation tools, editors, design products, or other customer facing platforms
Strong platform thinking and experience identifying shared capabilities that scale across multiple products or surfaces
A strong appreciation for product craft and user experience, with the ability to balance speed and quality
An AI native mindset, you actively build with LLMs and AI tools, and see AI as a fundamental shift in how products are built and experienced
Experience working closely with engineering on technically complex products, migrations, or platform investments
Comfort discussing trade offs around performance, reliability, scalability, and technical architecture
A customer first mindset with strong discovery skills and data informed decision making
Strong storytelling and communication skills that help align teams around a clear vision
A collaborative leadership style built on influence rather than authority
High agency with the ability to create clarity in ambiguous problem spaces
Strong product craft, including writing specifications, defining success metrics, and driving execution across multiple teams
Experience working effectively across distributed teams
A mindset of continuous learning, curiosity, and collaboration

Experience building products such as Figma, Canva, Notion, Webflow, Framer, Squarespace, or similar creation platforms
Experience platformising shared capabilities across multiple products
Experience launching AI assisted creation features in production
Experience with real time collaboration or modern editor architectures
Experience building multilingual or localisation products
*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust.

We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

What this job can offer you
This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Senior Product Manager, Fraud and Compliance, joining the Fintech area
As Remote grows and handles larger transaction volumes across countries, so does our exposure to fraud, credit risk, and compliance risk. This role owns the systems and strategies that protect Remote and its customers — from onboarding verification and screening, to credit risk assessment and reserve management, to fraud detection and enforcement across the full customer lifecycle.
You'll drive the evolution of our risk and compliance capabilities from reactive, rule-based controls toward proactive, automated systems that identify risk signals early and scale without proportional increases in manual effort. This is a high-autonomy, high-stakes role. You'll report to the Director of Product and work closely with Risk, Compliance, Treasury, Legal, Collections, and Engineering.

Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code is required. You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code and prototypes — not just write specs.
AI fluency. You have a point of view on how AI and automation can transform risk operations — from pattern detection to anomaly scoring to compliance workflows.
Seasoned Product Manager, with a track record on platform, API, or products for operational teams.
Platform mindset. You build systems others can extend. Scalability means growing the business without proportional increases in manual work or complexity.
Strong UX sensibilities . Risk and compliance tooling doesn't have to be painful. You care about the admin experience as much as the customer-facing one.
Outstanding communication and collaboration skills. You partner effectively with compliance, engineering, design, treasury, and legal — and you lead by example on async workflows.
Data-driven decision-making. Comfortable querying data and working with visualisation tools, you let insights drive your prioritisation.
Fast learner with a growth mindset. You're humble, eager to learn, and get up to speed quickly in new territory, then pass on what you pick up so the whole team levels up.
Great judgment - making strategic (what to prioritize) and tactical (feature scope) decisions.
Language: Business-level proficiency writing and speaking English.
Domain advantage (nice to have): Experience with risk/compliance platforms and third-party screening or fraud detection tooling.

Own credit risk assessment and reserve management: Drive the strategy for how Remote evaluates, scores, and mitigates credit risk. Evolve the underlying models and tooling to be smarter, faster, and more automated over time.
Fraud detection and prevention: Own fraud controls, freeze mechanisms, and dispute workflows. Build proactive strategies that detect and prevent fraud — not just react to it.
Compliance automation: Own end-to-end onboarding compliance — KYB verification, AML screening, and background checks. Drive automation to reduce manual effort while maintaining regulatory defensibility.
Build flexible, platform-oriented systems: Prefer solutions that operations teams can configure and extend without engineering involvement. Remove engineering as a bottleneck for responding to new risk and compliance patterns.
Collections and enforcement: Partner with Collections and Treasury on risk reserves, payment blocks, and enforcement actions. Own the admin and customer-facing surfaces that support this.
Ship iteratively at pace: Lead a product team delivering high throughput and high ROI. Advance key KPIs around automation rates, false-positive reduction, and risk accuracy.
Stakeholder management across risk, ops, and finance. Translate complex risk trade-offs into clear product decisions. Align with Compliance Operations, Treasury, Legal, and senior leadership.

Overview RealPage Payments is the purpose-built payments engine within the RealPage platform, powering rent, deposit, and fee payments across a broad range of property types.

By tightly integrating with RealPage’s property management solutions, RealPage Payments enables property management companies to streamline rent collection, reduce manual processing and fraud risk, and offer residents flexible, digital-first options to pay how, when, and where they prefer.

Responsibilities Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for 3–5 payment product lines, including both existing offerings and new products from concept through launch and scale.

Lead a cross-functional product pod (engineering, design, marketing, operations, and analytics) without direct people-management responsibility, setting priorities, clarifying requirements, and ensuring accountability for outcomes.

Define, track, and own key performance indicators (KPIs) for your product lines, including adoption, revenue, margin, client satisfaction, and resident experience.

Partner closely with Sales, Client Success, and key property management clients to deeply understand their needs, pain points, and opportunities—and translate these into clear product requirements and a prioritized roadmap.

Serve as the day-to-day product owner for your domain, writing user stories, managing backlogs, and making trade-off decisions that balance client value, technical feasibility, risk, and commercial impact.

Optimize and enhance existing products through experimentation, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement in areas such as UX, conversion, authorization rates, and operational efficiency.

Lead the end-to-end launch of new payment capabilities, including discovery, business case development, requirements, build, testing, rollout, training, and post-launch performance measurement. Collaborate with Pricing and Finance to shape pricing and packaging strategies that align with market dynamics, client value, and P&L goals.

Partner with Marketing and GTM teams to develop value propositions, positioning, messaging, and sales enablement materials that drive awareness, adoption, and expansion.

Act as a subject matter expert on RealPage Payments and the broader payments ecosystem (card, ACH, offline, alternative payments), staying current on industry trends, regulations, and competitive offerings. Participate in key client discussions and executive briefings as the product voice, supporting sales cycles and strategic account planning.

Work closely with Operations, Risk, and Compliance to ensure products are resilient, scalable, compliant, and deliver a reliable experience for property managers and residents.

Proactively identify product, process, and experience gaps, and drive cross-functional initiatives to address them Qualifications KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES 8+ years of product management experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or related technology businesses, with demonstrable ownership of significant product lines or platforms.

Proven track record of managing products end-to-end—from discovery and strategy through delivery, commercialization, and iterative optimization. Experience leading cross-functional pods or squads (engineering, design, marketing, operations) in an agile environment, with strong influence skills and no formal reporting lines.

Strong familiarity with payment flows (card, ACH, cash/offline, digital wallets) and payment economics; property management, real estate tech, or proptech experience is a plus. Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to define KPIs, measure product performance, and drive prioritization and decision-making.

Experience working closely with Sales and clients to inform roadmaps, co-create solutions, and support go-to-market and adoption. Strong business acumen and comfort with P&L levers, pricing, and commercial trade-offs.

Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear narratives for technical teams, commercial teams, and executive stakeholders. Hands-on experience with agile product development practices, backlog management, and user story creation.

Operates with an owner mindset, taking end-to-end accountability for outcomes and results. Customer-obsessed, energized by spending time with clients and users and turning insights into action. Highly collaborative and influential, able to align diverse stakeholders around a clear product vision and roadmap.

Structured and analytical, with a bias for action and experimentation. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. Passionate about building great payment experiences that make life easier for property managers and residents.

LocationOur Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT PartnerOps will be an integral part of our Product Management team. This role is based remotely in the East US, Canada, the UK or Ireland. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation.

We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity We’re hiring a Principal Technical Product Owner to drive the strategy, rapid delivery, and iteration for the DoiT Partner Platform. This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers.

The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery. This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset.

You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives , serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution.

You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts.

The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models.

In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization. Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Delivery
Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence.
Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components.
Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope.
Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio.
Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer.
Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding
Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models.
Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery.
Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses.
Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise
Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers.
Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as:

Multi-cloud billing aggregation.
Partner margin and discount models.
Customer invoicing and revenue operations.
Usage and cost transparency.
Marketplace and private offer workflows.

Executive & Partner Validation
Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions.
Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses.
Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership.
Engineering-Embedded Technical Product Ownership

Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning—ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
Ensure components are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior, supporting partner-grade reliability and scalability.
Quality, Outcomes, Trust & Governance

Instrument learning: ensure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into portfolio prioritization.
Ensure platform capabilities account for the operational realities of the cloud partner ecosystem, including billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and auditability.

Experience building or operating platforms that serve channel or partner-driven business models.

Technical fluency in cloud fundamentals and APIs across AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure.

A Brief Overview As a Supply Chain Product Owner, you will play a crucial role in driving the development and enhancement of supply chain management solutions within our organization.

You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and the development team, ensuring that the product aligns with the overall business strategy and meets the needs of both internal and external stakeholders.

This role requires a deep understanding of supply chain processes, strong communication skills, and the ability to prioritize and drive initiatives that add value to the organization's supply chain operations. What you will do Product vision and strategy:
· Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for supply chain management.
· Act as the lead SME for demand planning processes, ensuring best practices and continuous improvement.
· Lead and support demand planning system implementations and enhancement projects, ensuring alignment with business needs.
· Collaborate with key stakeholders, including operations, procurement, logistics, and IT, to understand business objectives and translate them into product requirements. Requirements Management:
· Elicit, document, and prioritize detailed requirements for supply chain management solutions both in partnership with a Business Analyst and without.
· Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that requirements are well-understood and incorporated into the product development process. Feature Prioritization:
· Prioritize features and enhancements based on business value, customer needs, and market trends.
· Make data-driven decisions and continuously reassess priorities to maximize the impact on supply chain efficiency. Development Collaboration:
· Collaborate with development teams, providing clear and concise guidance during the product development lifecycle.
· Participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. Quality Assurance:
· Work with QA teams to define acceptance criteria and ensure that the developed solutions meet the specified requirements and quality standards. Stakeholder Management:
· Act as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and the development team.
· Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders, and address their concerns in a timely manner. Continuous Improvement:
· Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency gains in the supply chain through technology solutions.
· Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in supply chain management. User Training and Support:
· Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for end-users to ensure the successful adoption of new supply chain solutions.
· Support and administer the demand planning application, including configuration, troubleshooting, and user support.
· Provide ongoing support and address user inquiries or issues related to the product. Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills with proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, BI tools). As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Japan. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Japan. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1.

Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

Own the execution of major product initiatives.
Partner closely with design and engineering from early exploration through launch.
Write product requirements, manage backlogs, and keep projects moving.
Facilitate planning, standups, reviews, and comms between teams.
Help teams make informed decisions through UXR, research, and using Midjourney deeply yourself.
Go deep on important product questions when needed, whether that means conducting user research, designing experiments, or working through a difficult product tradeoff.
Help teams decide what matters most and make smart choices about quality, scope, and speed.
You might be a fit if
You’ve spent the last several years building software people love to use.

Netlify runs on usage. Developers buy credits, teams consume compute and bandwidth, and enterprises commit to spend. The Accounts and Billing area owns how all of that works: the accounts foundation every customer signs into, the billing platform that meters and charges them, and the pricing and packaging model that sets what they pay. It sits at the center of how Netlify grows, and it touches Finance, Growth, UX, Sales, and the executive team.
As a Staff Product Manager, you’ll help define and evolve Netlify’s monetization model, bringing a strong point of view while partnering across the company to make high-impact decisions, and you will build hands-on next to engineering, Finance, and design rather than run a team from above. You’ll collaborate closely with senior leaders, including the CEO and CFO, as we continue to evolve Netlify’s pricing and packaging strategy.

Lead the strategy and evolution of pricing, packaging, and monetization, including plans and tiers, the credit and usage model, seat-versus-consumption economics, on-demand and overage rates, enterprise commitments and discounting, storage pricing, regional pricing, and annual plans.
Ship billing as a product: metering accuracy, invoicing, payments, refunds, and customer-facing usage visibility, including the billing and usage interfaces enterprises are asking for.
Steward the accounts foundation: sign-up and authentication, identity, orgs and teams and seats, roles and permissions, account security, and fraud and abuse at the top of the funnel.
Build and lead the pricing and packaging experimentation program, using data, customer insight, and sound judgment to guide decisions: product analytics, conversion and activation, and credit-consumption telemetry.
Partner with Finance to develop pricing approaches that balance customer value, business goals, and long-term sustainability.
Partner with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to set priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive alignment on the most impactful opportunities when demand exceeds capacity.

7+ years of product management experience, including experience leading pricing, packaging, monetization, or other commercially significant product initiatives for developer-focused, SaaS, or usage-based products.
Deep experience with usage-based, credit-based, subscription, or seat-based business models, including metering, tiering, overages, enterprise commitments, discounting, and the tradeoffs among them.
Hands-on depth with billing platforms (Orb, Stripe, Zuora, Metronome, or similar), billing pipelines and ledgers, and billing treated as a customer-facing surface.
A track record of driving measurable business outcomes, including revenue impact, through product strategy, experimentation, and execution.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

This is a defining opportunity for a Senior Product Manager to own how every Samsara device comes to life.
Samsara ships hundreds of thousands of devices a year to fleets, construction sites, and depots worldwide. A single customer rollout can exceed 50,000 devices , where every minute saved per install compounds into weeks of deployment time. Each device has a five-minute window where it goes from a box in someone's hands to a live sensor feeding a customer's operation. You will own those five minutes and the multi-year vision for what they become.
The install experience is critical to the compounding value of every Samsara product. A camera aimed correctly on day one trains better safety models. A gateway reporting cleanly makes every downstream workflow trustworthy.
You will own the software install experience end to end, with a dedicated engineering and design team, and you will own one number: install correctness , the share of installs completed right on the first attempt.

Correctness today swings by several points depending on whether the installer uses the Samsara Fleet App, and closing that gap for every install is the first prize. Your target is an install under five minutes of active app time that confirms its own health before the installer walks away.
You are building for two people who each get the same five minutes. A contracted technician on their twentieth install of the day wants speed. A customer's shop mechanic on their first wants guidance that assumes nothing. Both are standing in a truck bay, holding a phone, sometimes without signal.
To understand the scale of this problem, review the Samsara Vehicle Gateway here , our full hardware lineup here , and our installer partner network here .

You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Luno has spent over a decade making digital assets safe to own. Since 2013, we've helped millions of people across more than 40 countries buy, store and invest in crypto, working with regulators in every market and holding all customer crypto 1:1. That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on
The financial system is moving on-chain. Stablecoins are the only digital asset class operating at institutional scale today, and while 98% of supply is dollar-pegged, roughly half of global payment flows are not. That gap is the opportunity, and it is largest in exactly the markets Luno has spent twelve years building in.

You will join the Product Management team building Luno’s institutional business: the activation, digital asset account infrastructure and issuance products that let businesses, institutions and partners operate on Luno’s rails. The portfolio spans Luno Institutional and BlockTower, the group’s stablecoin issuance business. You'll report to the Group Product Manager and work in the BlockTower pod with dedicated engineering and UX partners.

BlockTower is the group’s institutional stablecoin issuance business, starting with ZARU, the South African rand stablecoin.

You'll own the products institutions touch: the self-service issuance platform, where treasury teams mint, redeem, distribute yield and report, and Wallet as a Service, which lets those institutions use and offer stablecoins inside their own products and flows.

Your job is to turn a working product into a repeatable one, and to build the foundation on which future local-currency stablecoins launch in new markets.

The issuance platform: the portal, mint and redeem flows, yield distribution, user and access management, approval workflows, statements and reporting
Wallet as a Service: how institutions embed wallets into their own platforms
The boundary: What the platform needs from the underlying Luno infrastructure, and holding the line on what BlockTower owns itself
Repeatability: the next currency, chain, market or wallet use case should be a configuration exercise, not a new build
Commercial shape: Take institutional customers live and convert every manual step in their journey into a self-service product
Customer-centric: Spend real time with the customers themselves: treasury teams, payment providers, market makers and financial institutions, and let their operating reality shape the roadmap
Build the controls institutions require to trust an issuer: auditability, segregation of duties, and reporting that their own compliance teams will accept

You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager, including taking a new product from zero to its first paying customers and then through the stage of making it repeatable
You have built for institutional users: treasury, payments, capital markets or banking
You deeply understand stablecoins and the economics of issuance: reserves, yield, minting and redemption, and you can reason about how a product decision moves each of them
You know your way around on-chain settlement - chains, custody, what moves on-chain versus off, well enough to make clear product trade-offs rather than defer them to engineering
You are comfortable operating a young business inside a larger group: small team, broad remit, decisions made with limited information and a parent company whose infrastructure you depend on
You work confidently in a regulated environment and can collaborate with legal and compliance on the controls a licensed issuer must carry
You are credible in the room with institutional customers, you've been the named person in a treasury team, PSP, market maker or bank calls, and you've turned what those relationships taught you into a roadmap
You use AI as part of how you work -in discovery, analysis, writing and prototyping, and you can show where it's changed your output , not just your tooling

The Position
This is an exciting time to join Remote and build a thriving ecosystem of HRIS integrations as a Senior Product Manager, HRIS Integrations .
Your mission: enable customers to sync their HRIS with Remote's employment infrastructure for Payroll, EOR, and Contractors through reliable, well-designed technical integrations. You will work deeply with Remote’s APIs and partner APIs, translating customer problems into data flows that are accurate, scalable, and easy to use.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success, you will bring the detail orientation, collaboration, and customer judgment needed to build integrations that work exceptionally well, solve real customer problems, and drive customer outcomes.
You report to a Senior Group Product Manager and collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure every HRIS integration succeeds commercially and technically.

Senior-Level Experience: Track record as a Product Manager with a strong focus on Integrations, APIs, or Platform ecosystems .
Customer Focus: Deep empathy for customers and a strong sense of what matters most in their day-to-day workflows.
Partner-Facing Experience: Proven experience building trusted relationships with external organizations and communicating clearly in partner-facing settings.
Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders, navigate trade-offs, and keep teams focused on what matters most for customers.
Strong UX Sensibilities: A passion for effortless experiences. You believe that data syncing, even at scale across jurisdictions, should feel simple and seamless to the end user.
Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code (Required): You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code and prototypes — not just write specs. You can understand sample code, API responses, and integration flows hands-on.
Domain Expertise (HRIS/Payroll - nice to have): Experience with HRIS and payroll platforms (Workday, HiBob, BambooHR, Personio, ADP, Paychex, or similar). You understand data models, sync patterns, and common integration pain points in the space.
Outstanding Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can explain complex technical integrations to non-technical executives and clearly articulate value to external partners.
Language: Business-level proficiency writing and speaking English.

Integration Architecture & Design: Lead deep-dive technical discovery into Remote’s APIs and partner APIs. Understand data mapping, data flows, authentication flows, API keys, edge cases, and compliance requirements across 100+ countries.
Customer-Led Prioritization: Prioritize integration work based on customer needs, product impact, technical feasibility, and operational complexity.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, operations, GTM, sales, CX, and partners. Translate customer and partner requirements into clear technical specs, manage dependencies, and unblock delivery.
Quality & Reliability: Sweat the details of data accuracy, sync reliability, error handling, observability, and supportability so integrations work well in real customer workflows.
Measure Integration Impact: Establish and track KPIs for technical performance and customer outcomes, including adoption, reliability, retention, and customer satisfaction.
Drive Product Feedback: Turn integration learnings into clear, actionable feedback for Remote teams — what to add, fix, and improve across APIs, CLIs, and the product overall.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
The opportunity
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead the strategy for Trucking Technology—the systems that plan, procure, dispatch, and settle every truck move in North America—and drive the unification of our fragmented ground transportation business into a single Flexport-owned platform by 2027. You will define the vision for how planning, procurement, and carrier experience integrate into one operating system and execute with high autonomy.
This unification is critical for Flexport's long-term vision of an automated supply chain. By owning the full stack, we will consolidate demand, capture leaking margin, and deliver a high-quality experience across modes. You will also drive the next generation of trucking automation—including AI-driven appointment scheduling and automated dispatch—to continue the strategic initiatives in our annual operating plan.
Sitting at the intersection of product, operations, and business, you will be measured by operational and financial impact rather than just features shipped. This role involves redesigning the operating processes themselves and persuading leadership to adopt new models. You will also raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship and sharper frameworks on our most complex product problems.
You will raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship, better frameworks, and sharper thinking on the hardest product problems we face. This is a role for someone with deep product experience, strong analytical instincts, ideally real trucking or ground transportation domain expertise, and the ability to operate at both the strategic and execution level in a complex, data-rich environment.

Own the vision and strategy for Flexport's unified Trucking Technology stack across planning, procurement, pricing, and carrier experience.
Lead the end-to-end trucking unification program, managing cross-domain change management and platform migration risks.
Drive automation and AI initiatives, such as automated dispatch and appointment scheduling, to remove manual work from the cargo lifecycle.
Deliver measurable business impact by optimizing cost-to-serve, procurement savings, and carrier performance metrics.
Reengineer and digitize underlying trucking workflows to establish a leaner operating model.
Modernize the carrier experience to reduce friction across load acceptance, scheduling, and payment touchpoints.
Collaborate with global Engineering, Design, and Operations teams to translate complex logistics workflows into intuitive systems.
Use data-driven frameworks to guide investment and represent your domain in strategic leadership forums.
Mentor PMs to raise the bar for product specs, prioritization, and communication across the team.
What You Should Have
8+ years of PM experience with a track record of owning complex product domains and delivering quantifiable business impact.
Deep expertise in trucking or ground transportation (FTL/LTL, procurement, dispatch, or TMS platforms) is highly desirable.
Experience leading large-scale platform consolidations or system unification programs without disrupting live operations.
Proven ability in operational process engineering—diagnosing, redesigning, and automating complex human workflows.
Strong analytical skills with SQL proficiency and experience building metrics frameworks to drive strategic decisions.
Skilled at shipping intuitive UX in data-dense domains and aligning cross-functional teams around a shared roadmap.
Ability to operate simultaneously at the high-level strategy and granular execution levels.
Excellent communication skills for framing trade-offs and presenting recommendations to senior leadership.
Technical degree (CS, Industrial Engineering) or equivalent technical depth is a plus.
